abstract.t: PSI-05 defines a cryptographic attestation framework for financial disclosures, enabling third parties to recompute and verify company filings against their published figures. It establishes a public ledger of sealed financial statements, a verification protocol using RFC 8785 canonicalization with Ed25519 (classical) and ML-DSA-65 (post-quantum) signatures, and an API for querying reconciliation results. The framework supports ASX, NYSE, NSE, LSE, and Euronext filings.
